summary: Reitar Logtech Holdings Ltd (NASDAQ: RITR), a Hong Kong smart logistics and automated warehousing firm, announced via Form 6-K on August 21, 2026 that its Board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $3.0 million of its Class A ordinary shares. Repurchases may occur in open market, privately negotiated transactions, or block trades, subject to market conditions and Rule 10b-18 and/or 10b5-1 limitations. Management will determine timing and amounts; the program is discretionary and may be suspended or discontinued. Funding will come from existing cash. Watch for actual repurchase cadence and potential liquidity impact.
